canonical_project: Aruba Hyper Cloud Data Center IT4 campus, Rome
notes: Aruba Rome campus (Tecnopolo Tiburtino, Via Giacomo Peroni 380): 74,000 sqm, five data centers totalling 30 MW IT at full build-out, EUR 300m+ invested; DC-A (Tier IV certified) operational since 2024, second building launched H1 2025 - campus still completing.
